title: Donald West is powered by tomorrow
summary: For Donald, what powers him with positive energy is simple: “Every new day gives you the opportunity to achieve anything you want.”
body_markdown:
One of his greatest influences was his father, whose character and strong work ethic provided the foundation for Donald's own determination. The lessons he learned growing up continue to guide him, both personally and professionally. Ask his friends and family to describe him, and they'll tell you he's strong-willed, kind, and determined – qualities that have carried him through a career defined by change, learning, and perseverance.


Donald’s career path was shaped in part by the opportunities available in his hometown. The options were straightforward: work in the oil and gas industry or move away. He chose the former, beginning his career in the drilling sector and developing a strong foundation in discipline, teamwork, and perseverance. When the industry experienced a downturn, Donald adapted by transitioning into oil and gas production. That shift marked the beginning of a long and successful career, giving him the opportunity to develop a broad technical skill set and extensive operational experience. Those experiences ultimately prepared him to join New Fortress Energy and take the next step in his career in the LNG industry.


Today, Donald serves as a **Liquefaction Control Room Operator** at NFE. His role is critical to maintaining safe, efficient, and reliable plant operations. From monitoring plant performance and optimizing production to responding to process upsets, he works closely with field operators and maintenance personnel to maintain operational integrity and keep production running consistently. It's a role that demands focus, technical knowledge, and the ability to respond when it matters most.


For Donald, the work is about more than keeping systems running. He’s motivated by the opportunity to solve problems, keep learning and make a meaningful impact. He takes pride in tackling challenges that require critical thinking and attention to detail, as well as producing work that is safe, reliable and high quality.
